text:
Meera: hey folks — two small life updates: i just accepted a promotion to Senior SWE 🎉 and also we’re expecting a baby in september! wanted to share cause y’all have been my work fam 💜
Jon: OMG congrats!!! :party_parrot: huge huge!!! when do we celebrate?
Priya: amazing!! double congrats :tada: we definitely need cake + tiny baby onesie photoshoot 😄
Alex: this calls for a potluck + surprise toast. Thurs 8/12 after 3pm?
Meera: thanks everyone!! 8/12 works for us — low-key pls, no balloons (baby allergic to latex? jk)
Tian: cake flavor poll — chocolate, lemon, or salted caramel? vote with emoji: :chocolate_bar: for choco, :lemon: for lemon, :candy: for salted caramel
Nora: :chocolate_bar: chocolate all the way
Sean: :candy: salted caramel if available
Maya: :lemon: lemon please (I’ll bring mini scones)
Priya: i can order a small tiered cake from Flour & Finch — they do dairy-free options. budget ok? say $60?
Jon: i’ll chip in $20 — Venmo jon.redwood. can someone keep a running list of contributors?
Alex: i’ll do a google sheet and add dietary notes (vegan/gluten/etc). link in #calendar invite
Meera: oh wow you guys are the best. registry link here: https://babylist.com/meera — feel free to ignore if you’d rather just bring snacks :)
Tian: remote folks — i’ll set up a zoom room and bring a little slideshow (guilty of baby name suggestions)
Nora: i’ll collect messages for a card. DM me by 8/10 if you want to add something short
Sean: can we do a tiny mom/promo roast? just 3 good-natured embarrassments max 😁
Maya: yes to roast. also emoji reactions for RSVP: :white_check_mark: attending in-person, :desktop_computer: remote watch party, :x: can’t make it
DevRelBot: Reminder set: "Meera celebration" on 2023-08-12 15:00 in Breakroom A (auto-alert 24h before)
Alex: assigning duties — Priya order cake, Nora collect card, Tian set up Zoom and slideshow, Jon coordinate funds 
Priya: got it. ordering tomorrow so i can confirm allergies on the sheet
Meera: you all are ridiculous and amazing. thank you. i’ll bring tiny cupcakes for the team’s tiny humans (and a non-latex balloon for Sean) ❤️
